title: Trading journal
subtitle: Recorded to learn from, not to judge yourself with.
empty: No entries yet. Add your first trade.

positions.title: Positions
positions.howItWorksBody: This screen is not linked to your broker account and never places an order for you. It is a manual log of the trades you opened yourself. You execute at your broker, record it here, and the app pulls the current price to track R and tell you when the stop can move to break-even.
positions.whyManualBody: Because this system deliberately does not trade for you. The decision and the execution are yours. Its job is to read the market, warn you, and measure the result honestly afterwards.
positions.step1: Find a setup on the Setups screen, and if you want it, execute at your broker.
positions.step2: Come back here, tap "Open a position" and enter the price and stop you actually got.
positions.step3: The app pulls the live price, tracks R, and tells you when break-even is genuinely earned.
positions.step4: When you close at your broker, tap "Close trade" here. It moves into the Journal for review.
positions.openNewHint: Enter the price you actually filled at. Accurate beats flattering.
positions.prefillFromSetup: Use prices from the latest setup
positions.prefilled: Prices pulled from the engine's plan. Adjust them to your real fill.
positions.noQuote: Could not fetch the current price, so R cannot be computed yet.
positions.liveNote: The current price comes from the same engine endpoint the rest of the app uses, so management advice matches the chart.

form.noSetupLink: Not linked to a scanned setup
form.noSetupWarning: If it did not come from a scanned setup, it is recorded as an off-plan trade.
form.notePlaceholder: What were you thinking, why did you enter, how did it feel?

classification.label: Trade classification
classification.hint: A loss taken correctly is not a mistake. A loss from breaking your plan is.
classification.valid_loss_hint: Good setup, followed the plan, market went the other way — normal cost of business.
classification.bad_setup_hint: Low setup quality. It should not have been taken.
classification.good_setup_bad_execution_hint: The read was right; entry, exit or size was not.
classification.emotional_trade_hint: Not from a scanned setup, or taken against your own plan.
classification.missed_trade_hint: The setup was valid but you did not take it.
classification.valid_win_hint: Good setup, followed the plan, and it worked.

metrics.title: Your performance
metrics.notEnough: Not much data yet. These numbers start to mean something with more trades.

excursion.title: Where price went while you held
excursion.hint: High MFE but small result means you exit early. Repeatedly deep MAE means the entry is poorly located.

missed.title: Missed setups
missed.subtitle: Only setups the system called valid at the time — not things that merely look good in hindsight.
missed.noHindsight: Setups that did not qualify at the time are never counted as missed opportunities.

falseEntry.title: When the read was wrong
falseEntry.subtitle: All of it is kept. History is never rewritten.

rules.title: Your trading rules
rules.subtitle: Written in your own words. The system warns you when you are about to break one.
rules.placeholder: e.g. no more than 2 entries per day / no entry while timeframes conflict
rules.empty: No rules yet. Start with the single rule you break most often.

storage.localHint: No database configured, so entries live in this browser. Clearing browser data deletes them.

originalLanguage: This entry was written in {{lang}}. The system does not overwrite the original.
